name: Shri Jain Shwetamber Bhandar Tirth Bhojanshala
why_it_matters: The dining hall (bhojanshala) inside the Shri Jain Shwetamber Bhandar Tirth at Pawapuri — the site of Mahavira's nirvana around 500 BCE. Strictly Jain pure-veg by religious bylaw, fixed sittings (Navkarshi-9:30am breakfast, 11:30am-1:30pm lunch, 5pm-before-sunset dinner), no onion/garlic/root vegetables. Open to pilgrims and walk-in visitors.
insider_tip: Sittings are fixed by Jain dietary timing — arrive 10 minutes early or eat at the next slot. The complex enforces no leather inside; remove belts and watches at the entrance. Manager: Mr. Mishra.
signature_address: Shri Jain Shwetamber Bhandar Tirth, Nalanda Pavapuri Post, Nalanda District, Bihar 803115
